title: R49: deterministic counters gate inclusively, timing shapes are telemetry
note: PT1-PT5: the ceiling semantics by kind, the telemetry classification, the retired series.

mutations.name: PT1_deterministic_exclusive
mutations.rationale: a counter AT its invariant (0 directory entries listed) is flagged, so invariants of zero cannot be stated

mutations.name: PT2_deterministic_unbounded
mutations.rationale: a counter past its invariant passes

mutations.name: PT3_timing_inclusive
mutations.rationale: a timing shape exactly at its gross bound passes

mutations.name: PT4_unclassed_hidden
mutations.find: unknown = [m["guard"] for m in seen if m.get("kind") not in KINDS]
mutations.rationale: an unclassed measurement is published as if it were classed

mutations.name: PT5_report_skips_unrecorded
mutations.rationale: a guard with no timing history is never checked against its ceiling
